prompt: Gabriel synthesis of butylamine: potassium phthalimide + 1-bromobutane, then hydrazine (NH2NH2). Draw the amine product.
explanation: The phthalimide N is acidic (two EWG C=O's) → deprotonated by K+ to make N-nucleophile that does SN2 on R-X. Hydrazine then cleaves off the phthalyl group, releasing a clean 1° amine (never over-alkylates — the trick of this method).
